intro: Use this pounds to kilograms converter to turn lbs into kg accurately for body weight, airline luggage, and barbell plates. Comparing one pound to one kilo? A single avoirdupois pound equals exactly 0.45359237 kilograms under the 1959 International Yard and Pound Agreement, while 1 kg equals 2.204623 lb. Whether you are converting US pounds to kilograms on shipping manifests, tracking fitness progress, or reading a lbs to kgs chart, every result and table row below uses the exact international factor.

mistakesAndEdgeCases.title: Exact NIST Factor vs. Early Rounding Drift
items: The exact conversion factor from Pound (Avoirdupois) to Kilogram is 0.45359237, derived from the 1959 International Yard and Pound Agreement (1 lb = 0.45359237 kg).
Using a rough ÷ 2.2 shortcut introduces ~0.2% error (over 0.3 kg off on a 350 lb barbell). Always multiply by 0.45359237 first and round only the final number.

faqs.question: How many kilograms (kg) are in 1 pound (avoirdupois) (lb)?
faqs.answer: There are exactly 0.45359237 kilograms (kg) in 1 pound (avoirdupois) (lb), which rounds to 0.4536 kg for everyday calculations. Conversely, 1 kilogram equals 2.204623 pounds.

faqs.question: How do I convert pounds to kilograms (lb to kg)?
faqs.answer: To convert pounds to kilograms, multiply the pound value by 0.45359237 (kg = lb × 0.45359237). For example, 45 lb × 0.45359237 equals 20.4117 kg.

faqs.question: What is 153 pounds in kilograms?
faqs.answer: 153 pounds (lb) equals 69.39963 kilograms (kg)—about 69.4 kg—computed using the exact international factor 0.45359237.
